# 02 — COPD cohort and prescription orders (SHORT)

[Full notebook](../notebooks/02_cohort_and_exposures.ipynb)

## Objective

Select COPD admissions and build binary and class-specific pre-ICU prescription-order indicators.

## Input

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_icu`
- MIMIC-IV v3.1 `diagnoses_icd` and `prescriptions`.

## Output and downstream use

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd`
- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd_raas`
- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd_raas_detailed`

## Key methods and scope

- Executes the three corresponding `02_*.sql` scripts; COPD selection uses the existing ICD-9/10 diagnosis-code rules.
- Qualifying inpatient prescription records must be in the same admission and have `starttime <= intime`, including equality.
- Binary and ACEi-only/ARB-only/both/neither flags describe qualifying orders, not verified administration, adherence, or simultaneous treatment.
- Neither means no qualifying order under this definition; it does not prove absence of all medication use.
- Displays aggregate exposure counts and compares total rows with distinct ICU stays.
